scope: Conditional funding response to existing quarterly operating/timing stresses. Preserve original no-draw results and all operating/capital assumptions. No core model or pitch changes.
rate_status: Illustrative fixed annual simple borrowing rates, charged rate/4 per quarter. No contract-spread or future SOFR quote verified.
tax_status: Zero cash benefit is the conservative case; 15% immediate cash benefit is conditional on usable deductions and follows the inherited near-term tax normalization. Neither is a tax-return forecast.
draw_rule: At quarter start, draw the minimum amount needed for forecast quarter-end economic cash to equal 20B after interest. Charge a full quarter interest on both opening debt and new draw. Algebraically solve draw=[20 - baseline quarter-end cash - accumulated financing cash change + opening debt * quarterly rate * (1-tax)]/[1-quarterly rate*(1-tax)] when positive.
repayment_rule: At quarter end, repay outstanding revolver up to cash exceeding 20B, after interest and any tax benefit. No draws or repayments added to operating cash. Preserve original base cash-income budget; no incremental interest income credited.
fee_boundary: No commitment fee, utilization fee or transaction cost calibrated. Report gross interest and an explicit per-$1M fee price sensitivity. Unknown fees prevent calling this all-in cost.
claims_and_value_rule: Borrowing creates equal cash and debt. End2030 equity target changes by net financing cash minus outstanding incremental debt, normally accumulated after-tax interest cost once repaid. For planning APV, pair draw proceeds with contractual interest/principal discounted at the assumed loan rate. Pretax financing NPV must equal zero; do not deduct interest again from unlevered operating DCF. Show conditional cash-tax shield NPV separately and credit no uplift to the headline planning value.

price_reference.source_status: Parent verified regular-session close; not independently verified in this claims subtask.

limitations: Quarter-end economic owner cash, not daily bank cash or fully accessible unrestricted cash.
Future facility access, representations, covenants, lender performance and available capacity remain conditional.
Capacity is not equity value; no $15B addition.
Base cases need no draw; use only under the existing concentrated-timing stresses.
